versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.4 – Major documentation upgrade and new design system features.

- Overhauled SKILL.md with detailed bilingual (Chinese & English) documentation on design principles, templates, and usage.
- Added support for 58 high-quality design templates, covering Chinese and international products.
- Introduced a 9-part DESIGN.md output structure to standardize design system documentation for AI use.
- Provided five complete professional templates (e.g., Xiaohongshu, Stripe, Linear) with practical usage instructions.
- Emphasized fully local, dependency-free operation focused on privacy and code transparency.
- Listed extended documentation and code audit resources for enhanced usability and security.
